Name: Poki's Lokis
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Adds a shopkeeper to the Cindersap Forest, west of the Hat Mouse, named Poki. (Poki uses xe/xem/xyr/xyrs/xemself pronouns. Xe is friends with the Hat Mouse. You cannot talk to xem, xe is just a map tile at the moment, but I may be making xem into an NPC in 1.6.) Xe sells various seeds and recipes. [b]Compatible with SVE, Stardew Reimagined 3, and Cape Stardew. Xe is not an alien, xe just uses neopronouns. [/b]Also xe dyes xyr hair differently each season. 
In the current version (3.0.0), only adds xem and xyr shop, will add the items back in later. Xe sells forage and crop flowers every day based on the season. You can also sell xem any fruits, veggies, flowers, and forage.

In this mod, xe sells flower seeds on Mondays and Fridays, bouquet recipes for each of the roses added in this mod, (which match the bouquet replacement mod I published) and special vanilla seeds on Wednesdays, (xe sells year 2 seeds, seeds purchasable from Sandy (after you have met her), and Ginger Island seeds (after you have unlocked the Island Trader). Xe also sells seasonal vanilla flowers every day. Xyr shop is open every day from 6 am to 8 pm, in any weather, and on festival days. After the shop is closed, it is still there, but xyr cat, Amalis, a magical stardrop cat, is sleeping on the stall. Please do not wake Amalis, she is a very tired kitty. (You cannot buy items from Amalis.)
This mod also adds in a bunch of new flowers. All of the seeds are only purchasable from Poki. There are roses growing on the bushes that you can gather.
There are 24 different roses, 6 per season.
Also, there are two types of flower that grow in 28 colors each, 7 of each per season.
One type is shaped like a cat's head. They are called "Meowers" (named by sparten09 on discord).
The other type is shaped like a heart with eyes (don't ask why they have eyes). They are called "Kør Flørs".
Poki will also be selling all of my other crop seeds, flower seeds, saplings, and purchasable recipes from all of my other mods in updates to those mods.
All of the roses can become giant and can be made into Nekylos (nectar jelly) in the keg and can be tapped for Nekylos if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13052]Tap Giant Crops[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/116553368]atravita[/url]. The roses grow on a trellis, but are not coded as trellis crops, so you can walk through them. The roses also regrow. All of the items added by this mod have vanilla NPC gift tastes. Also the shop, called Poki's Lokis (means "Poki's Location" in one of my conlangs), is compatible with both SVR3 and SVE.
